items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I went to Cincinnati; I went to school there, for tailoring and while I was there I joined Wes Helvey's band.

ctx.x: O.K., now I'll straighten you out again. I went to Cincinnati; I went to school there, for tailoring and while I was there I joined Wes Helvey's band. Understand? Straight?
I think I am now. You got that, Donald?
